entities.name: Federico Nicolás Sánchez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Federico Nicolás Sánchez is an Argentine retired rugby union player who last played as a fly-half for Tucumán Lawn Tennis Club in the Nacional de Clubes. Sánchez is widely regarded as one of the greatest Argentine players ever and one of the greatest fly-halves ever.
